# KeyFlint & Flint MCP Ecosystem

> KeyFlint (https://keyflint.dev) is a self-hosted cryptographic licensing and atomic credit-metering gateway for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, CLIs, and APIs. It powers the Flint production MCP hub (https://mcp.keyflint.dev).

## Core Capabilities
- **Offline Ed25519 License Verification (< 1 ms)**: Issue signed `LIC-<TIER>-<payload>.<signature>` tokens with `kid` key rotation, node locking, and domain locking. MIT SDKs for Python (`pip install keyflint-verify`), TypeScript (`npm i keyflint-verify`), and Go.
- **Atomic SQLite WAL Credit Metering**: Per-call `@metered(credits=N)` decorator and `@keyflint/wrap` zero-code stdio wrapper with idempotency keys and automatic refunds (`/api/v1/quota/refund`) when a tool fails or returns `isError: true`.
- **Passwordless OAuth 2.1 (6-Digit OTP)**: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP authentication (`/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`) resolving verified email addresses directly to active Ed25519 licenses via `/api/v1/licenses/by-customer`.
- **Direct Stripe & LemonSqueezy Webhooks**: Zero platform cut; automatic provisioning, top-ups on the same key, and dispute/refund revocation.

## Live Production MCP Servers (Flint by KeyFlint · https://mcp.keyflint.dev)
- **Despacho Unified Connector** (`https://mcp.keyflint.dev/despacho/mcp`): Single OAuth 2.1 URL uniting 17 banking (AEB Norma 43) and accounting (ContaBridge) tools for Spanish accounting firms.
- **Norma 43 MCP** (`https://mcp.keyflint.dev/norma43/mcp`): Deterministic parser and balance validator for Spanish bank statements (`.n43`, `.c43`, CaixaBank, BBVA, Santander, Sabadell, Bankinter, Abanca).
- **ContaBridge MCP** (`https://mcp.keyflint.dev/contabridge/mcp`): Converts bank CSV / Norma 43 and Facturae XML into import-ready journal files for ContaSol, A3, Sage 50, and ContaPlus.
- **Veri*factu MCP** (`https://mcp.keyflint.dev/verifactu/mcp`): AEAT RD 1007/2023 SHA-256 invoice hash-chain verifier, Facturae 3.2.2 auditor, NIF/CIF/IBAN validator, and QR generator.
- **DataClean MCP** (`https://mcp.keyflint.dev/dataclean/mcp`): Deterministic CSV/JSON normalization, deduplication, and schema validation.
- **Web-Intel MCP** (`https://mcp.keyflint.dev/web-intel/mcp`): Clean Markdown extraction, structured table parsing, and metadata inspection for AI agents.
